def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=min(set(x for row in grid for x in row))
    # horizontal separator rows are rows with no background cells
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if bg not in row]
    # vertical separator columns are positions carrying non-background marker on a horizontal boundary
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in rs)]
    # output corresponds to marker locations excluding the leftmost boundary column when it is a border
    # choose marker columns that recur in the row pattern
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cs if grid[r][c]!=bg] for r in rs[:-1]]
